notes.title: v1.4a - Bug fixes, gameplay tweaks and UI additions!
notes.content:
[h2]Hi folks![/h2]

After showcasing Sleepytime Village at WASD, I noticed several areas that needed improvement, including gameplay changes, UI additions to guide the player, and bug fixes.

So, in v1.4a, you will see:

[b]BUG FIXES[/b]

Resolved a couple of freezes caused by minor bugs.
[b]UI ADDITIONS[/b]

Menu tweaks and UI guidance for starting the first scene.
[b]GAMEPLAY TWEAKS[/b]

New graphical elements, enhanced gameplay features like new footstep sounds, and increased walking speed.
All these updates should make the game experience even better!

Also, while I have your attention, the Kickstarter for Sleepytime Village is currently live. We're doing well but could use a bit more support! Please check it out [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/lightfootbrosgames/sleepytime-village]here[/url], and consider backing the game by choosing one of the physical rewards.

Your support would make a big difference!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42634781/8edbc1bfaa57274f011405039e6ac9f5b57fa2b6.gif[/img]

Thanks so much!

Let me know your thoughts or feedback on the updated build!

notes.title: MASSIVE new update to the Sleepytime VIllage Demo!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

We've been working hard to bring you the updated [b]v1.2 of Sleepytime VIllage demo[/b], with tons of new features, gameplay tweaks, options and bug fixes! These have been implemented from listening to the wonderful feedback from YOU GUYS!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42634781/befa845bb914d3bea09a176ec659988045ba2d2c.png[/img]

[b]Gameplay changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] You now get to play more of the game, and to complete the demo you have to escape MeMe's house!
[*] Edited first screen with a tighter storyline, no need to pick up all the objects and no time limit, this is now a scene setter
[*] Removed inventory baggage - items that are not relevant to the demo have been removed for until you play the full game!
[*] Extended bedroom scene cutscene to show the upstairs exit clearly
[*] Extended upstairs garden scene intro to show the full breadth of the room
[/list]

[b]Graphical changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] New start screen
[*] Removed items have a cloud POP graphic
[*] Detail to Upstairs garden
[/list]

[b]Options changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Swearing off/on
[*] Windowed
[*] Fullscreen
[*] Three inventory position options - Bottom, Top, Fullscreen
[*] Resolution options
[/list]

[b]Bug fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Rufus freezing on some interactions fixed
[*] Autosave fixed
[*] Some speech audio missing now in
[*] Minor bugs fixed
[/list]

So there we have it! ENJOY and let me know your feedback!

Thank you, you wonderful lot!

James x

notes.content:

[*] Examining the Leaflet from Inventory Bag, back arrow now working

Enjoy and if you like it please leave a review, wishlist and tell your friends!

James

notes.title: Demo Patch update!
notes.content:
Thanks to everyone who has already downloaded the demo! We had to get it out in time for Steam Next Fest last month and even though that was a fantastic experience, we didn't quite get to put out the finished article. We now have had the chance to add extra animations, nuances, fixes and even more gloss to make the demo the release we wanted!

Please enjoy, we are a small but open team and will always reply to the community if you ever have questions, suggestions or fixes to help make this game / demo as good as it can be! 

Thank you to you all!

Lightfoot Bros
